infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to show when to leave for your stop, to share a driver's bus position during a trip, and - only with your consent and inside your travel window - to confirm attendance. Student locations are never stored.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera scans the boarding QR code shown on the driver's phone.
